{
  "name": "nowloading",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "The line that animates while Claude works, redrawn as something from before: tape decks, departure boards, an hourglass, a floppy drive, a dot-matrix printer, an arcade rally, a filmstrip, and a pixel campfire.",
  "author": {
    "name": "vgnshiyer"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/vgnshiyer/nowloading",
  "repository": "https://github.com/vgnshiyer/nowloading",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "spinner",
    "nostalgia",
    "retro",
    "vhs"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Theme",
      "description": "The animation drawn while Claude works. /nowloading <theme> also picks one for every session; whichever you set last wins. random picks a new one each turn.",
      "default": "rewind",
      "options": [
        "rewind",
        "channel3",
        "cassette",
        "platform",
        "arrivals",
        "sandglass",
        "floppy",
        "dotmatrix",
        "rally",
        "filmstrip",
        "campfire",
        "random"
      ]
    }
  }
}
